# nico_measured_boot_trusted_machine (Resource)

Measured Boot Trusted Machine endpoints manage automatic measurement promotion approvals for Machines at a Site

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_measured_boot_trusted_machine" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  machine_id                     = "machine-id-value"
  approval_type                  = "approval-type-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `approval_type` (String) Whether the approval is consumed once or persists for future reports.
- `machine_id` (String) Machine UUID, or `*` to approve all Machines at the Site.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site where the approval applies.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Optional operator comments about the approval.
- `pcr_registers` (String) Optional comma-separated PCR register selector. All registers are used when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `approval_id` (String) Unique approval ID.
- `created` (String) Time when the approval was created, or null when Core did not return a timestamp.
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
